name: Compute Cluster S20: Top-K Selection (select + cs_select)
description: Tests: select() builtin for top/bottom N count mode, cs_select for percent mode, cross-sectional rotation with momentum ranking.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S20: Top-K Selection
# Tests: select() count mode, cs_select percent mode, rotation
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === MOMENTUM METRIC ===
ret_1mo = returns(close, 21)
ret_3mo = returns(close, 63)
momentum = ret_3mo

# === SELECT: count mode (top/bottom N) ===
# select() builtin: pick top N assets by metric
is_top_1 = select(momentum, n=1, direction=SelectDirection.Top)
is_bottom_1 = select(momentum, n=1, direction=SelectDirection.Bottom)

# === CS_SELECT: percent mode (top/bottom %) ===
is_top_50pct = cs_select(direction='top', mode='percent', k=50)(momentum)

# === REPORTERS ===
cs_lines(
    title='3M Momentum by Asset',
    category='Selection'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=momentum)

cs_lines(
    title='Top-1 Selection Flag',
    category='Selection'
)(x_values=index(), y_values=1.0 if is_top_1 else 0.0)

cards(
    category='Selection',
    layout=CardLayout(title='Selection Counts', cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Bars in Top 1', card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Bars in Bottom 1', card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Bars in Top 50%', card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
    ])
)(where(is_top_1, close), where(is_bottom_1, close), where(is_top_50pct, close))
